# Publication animation fixtures

These original test images were generated with Pillow. Each file contains two
240 × 140 frames: a red panel marked “1” and a blue panel marked “2”, 600 ms per
frame, looping continuously. The files exercise GIF, animated WebP, APNG and
animated AVIF without third-party image content. Publication tests compare all
bytes before and after upload; browser verification checks animation after import.
